Question
========
What is the main goal of data acquisition?

Answerlist
----------
* improve interpretability of collected data
* collect relevant data for analysis
* dispose outdated data
* filter only relevant and accurate data


Solution
========
The main goal of data acquisition is to collect relevant data for analysis.
